thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed from Dedicated cluster dc-west-3 for tenant nebulacorp. Error rate jumped to 18% over 5m. Paging oncall.
Maya: @here oncall is me for today, I'm taking. Kicking off triage.
Joel: grabbing logs, looks like KV evictions + inflight queue backed up. cc @Anita for routing/rls.
Anita: seeing repeated `ERROR: connection reset by peer` from model-gateway pods. Also a flurry of long tail latencies (p95>2s).
Sahil: funneling raw trace: https://internal.redwood/traces/4132100000
Maya: quick customer impact check — hooking into support dashboard now, @account-manager-bot any active escalations from NebulaCorp?
account-manager-bot: NebulaCorp SLA contact: Elena. No active open tickets in last 48h.
Elena: I'm on standby, will notify if customer-visible errors spike. Please keep me posted.
Joel: digging into node metrics — GPU utilization for pool-dc-west-3 at 98%, host-level oom_kill events on two nodes, high swap pressure. Looks like a noisy job saturated memory and caused kernel to evict KV caches.
Anita: that matches: K/V cache misses cascading into longer model startup -> increased concurrency -> more queueing -> 5xx. Probable noisy neighbor causing capacity exhaustion.
Maya: mitigation plan: 1) apply temporary per-tenant connection limit for nebulacorp at the gateway 2) spin up 2 reserved nodes in dc-west-3 3) route a subset of traffic to dc-east-1 fallback pool. Any objections?
Sahil: +1. Recommend immediate per-tenant throttling rule: `limit.concurrency=8` for tenant nebulacorp and aggressive circuit-breaker at 500ms.
Joel: I'll trigger scale-up of dedicated pool now: `infractl scale pool dc-west-3 --add-nodes 2 --reason "noisy-tenant mitigation"` — running.
Anita: applying gateway rule: `rdwctl routes patch --tenant nebulacorp --conn-limit 8` — done. Observability: adding temporary alert to mute noisy paging: `incident-bot silence 4132100000 30m`.
Maya: redirecting 10% of NebulaCorp traffic to dc-east-1 via smart-routing policy `fallback-prob=0.1` while we stabilize.
Joel: scale operation returned: new nodes provisioning, kube nodes joining. Noticed one node failing healthcheck — draining and recreating.
Sahil: logs after throttling show immediate drop in inflight queue from 450 -> 120, 5xx rate falling to ~6%.
Elena: reporting to customer: "We've detected elevated errors caused by resource contention on your dedicated cluster. We've applied temporary limits and are adding capacity — this should reduce errors within minutes. We'll follow up with a root cause and remediation." Sending now.
account-manager-bot: Message to NebulaCorp sent via email and portal.
Maya: quick sanity check: run `kubectl logs -n model-gateway --selector=tenant=nebulacorp --since=5m | grep ERROR | wc -l` -> logs show reduced ERROR count, still a few timeouts but trending down.
Joel: suggestion for next actions: 1) identify offending noisy job and schedule eviction + throttle at tenant resource manager 2) run cache warmup script on new nodes to repopulate KV 3) postmortem + customer RCA.
Anita: I can write an eviction script. Proposed command: `tenantctl evict --tenant nebulacorp --target-job job-4821 --grace 30` — but we should confirm tenant-ownership of job-4821.
Sahil: telemetry shows job-4821 is from NebulaCorp's high-throughput reranker pipeline. If we evict, they will have degraded throughput; we should coordinate with Elena.
Elena: agreed, hold eviction until I confirm with customer. Meanwhile keep throttles in place.
Maya: timeline: t+2m throttles -> visible improvement, t+10m scale nodes healthy, t+30m rollback throttles as KV warmed. I'll keep the thread updated. Marking incident status: mitigated (partial).
incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE: incident 4132100000 mitigated -> partial. 5xx rate now 2.1%. Notifications sent to oncall and account manager.
Joel: follow-up ops tasks assigned: - identify noisy process and add tenant-level CPU/mem caps - add automatic KV pre-warm during scale events - add better backpressure at gateway.
Maya: I'll put together a short blameless postmortem and schedule a cross-team sync with infra, routing, and customer success. ETA for draft: EOD.
Elena: I'll coordinate messaging with NebulaCorp for a post-incident summary and ask about acceptable remediation (eviction vs. quota increase).
Sahil: saved artifacts: traces, kube-events, infractl logs -> /artifacts/incidents/4132100000
Maya: handing off to night oncall @Joel in 20m. If anything regresses -> page immediately.
Joel: taking handoff, thanks. Will monitor 1h and then reduce alert noise if stable.
Elena: closing loop with customer after 2h observation window.
Maya: thanks team, nice quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
